claims: Cameron Young won the 2026 Players Championship.
Cameron Young earned $4.5 million as the top prize in the 2026 Players Championship.
The 2026 Players Championship had a total purse of $25 million.
The 2026 Players Championship was played at TPC Sawgrass.
Matt Fitzpatrick received $2.725 million as runner-up in the 2026 Players Championship.
Xander Schauffele took third place in the 2026 Players Championship and received $1.725 million.
The winner's share in the 2026 Players Championship is the largest in PGA Tour regular-season history.
Robert MacIntyre finished 4th in the 2026 Players Championship and received $1,225,000.
Ludvig Åberg finished 5th in the 2026 Players Championship and received $925,000.
6th place in the 2026 Players Championship paid $906,250.
7th place in the 2026 Players Championship paid $843,750.
8th place in the 2026 Players Championship paid $781,250.
9th place in the 2026 Players Championship paid $731,250.
10th place in the 2026 Players Championship paid $681,250.
The 2026 Players Championship maintained the $25 million purse established in 2025.
